status: Named focused evidence retained; final shared integration passed80/80 suites.

queue.bounds: 100 entries, 16 MiB compact queue JSON; 32 attachment references per message
queue.metadata: Original attachment refs/pathReferences/pathMetadata retained; queue host IDs removed from provider messages
queue.behavior: Enqueue while busy; remove/edit/reorder; Send now stops current turn and prioritizes selected entry; successful completion drains one at a time; Stop/final failure retain queue paused; restart requires explicit continuation
queue.durability: QueueCommitter saves candidate history and queue before publication or provider dispatch; SessionStore revision guard and atomic save apply
nativeExtensions: Editing queued text is an explicit native control in addition to pinned reorder/remove/Send now UI
Restored queued messages deliberately wait for explicit Resume or new send
Per-turn host configuration hook refreshes context and app mounts before network dispatch

questions.restart: Pending form UI/draft is ephemeral like source pending question state; restored unresolved tool calls use inherited-history recovery before next submission, not automatic replay
questions.interruption: User message returns completed=false/cancelled=false and partial answers plus notice before following user history; user cancel and Stop return structured cancellation reasons
questions.rendering: Native Qt controls, bounded host scroll wrapper, explicit Write a message instead/Back to questions; shared protected Markdown renderer denies implicit local or remote image access
questions.correlation: Unique host phase token plus turn lifetime; token rotates after Next/Back, so stale answers from a previous visit to the same step cannot apply
questions.schema: 1-5 steps; 1-10 fields per step; input/radio-group/checkbox/checkbox-group; defaults, constraints, optional Other
questions.bounds: 256 KiB form, 8192-character strings, 100 options per field, 128 KiB draft/step answer object

findings: Queue reorder initially held QJsonValueRef across removeAt, invalidating the moved value; two meaningful queue cases failed before fix and pass after explicit value copy

Four initial protocol fixture assertions incorrectly required UI display metadata to remain running; corrected to assert identical canonical/native payload, stable display ID, and output-available terminal state
Peer review identified QTextBrowser-only resource denial insufficient; QuestionPanel now reuses the protected transcript document and image-object handler, with actual local sentinel image regression
remaining: No live provider/service credentials or network APIs were used; fixtures use loopback servers and synthetic values
Partial in-progress form drafts are not durable across application restart
No claim of full Stagewise parity or universal defect absence
sourceHashEncoding: SHA-256 of source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; no other byte changes.
sourceHashScope: Current production/test source snapshot at this refresh. Earlier focused reports remain historical; latestSharedVerification identifies the retained completed shared reports. Later source edits require another hash refresh.

latestSharedVerification.scope: Only the listed completed shared suites; no claim about the aggregate all-suite run, release export, complete parity or universal defect absence.

historicalFocusedTests.actualMainWindow: 6/6 passed in root shared build (reported by parent); includes busy queue restart/Resume, question answer/cross-chat guard, partial-answer interruption/narrow layout, and save conflict

questionCapabilityPolicy.nativeDefault: Disabled in standalone/headless AgentEngine; setQuestionToolEnabled(true) is an idle-only opt-in.
questionCapabilityPolicy.gui: MainWindow explicitly enables structured questions for its chat engines.
questionCapabilityPolicy.disabledBehavior: askUserQuestions is omitted from tool definitions; unsolicited calls return a tool error instead of waiting for a nonexistent form. An opt-in attempted during an active turn has no effect.
questionCapabilityPolicy.regression: headlessQuestionsAreNotAdvertisedOrWaitedOn covers OpenAI-compatible chat, Responses, Anthropic and Google; existing explicit question completion cases retain exact provider associations.

formGeometryCorrection.cause: QScrollArea cached the initially empty or pre-measure child hint; deferred protected Markdown measurement could leave controls unnecessarily clipped.
formGeometryCorrection.implementation: ContentControlsScrollArea uses the current child layout/height-for-width and updates geometry after layout requests; overflow remains scrollable at minimum window size.
regressions: Actual MainWindow at350x750 shows answer and Submit in the current controls viewport; at350x250 it remains resizable, scrolls to Submit, and sends the entered answer to the next loopback provider request.
SideChatPane at350x750 retains answer/Submit/queue controls; at350x250 it exposes bounded scrolling.
Actual side-chat host verifies question/queue control centers in the viewport for light/dark themes and1100/350 widths.

finalSharedIntegration.scope: Named suite reports and exact tested source hashes are retained in the final aggregate. Focused/historical evidence above remains scoped to its original observation; full upstream parity is not implied.
